text: In characteristic p, the map φ(a) = aᵖ is a ring homomorphism called the ___ endomorphism.
explanation: Additivity is the 'freshman's dream': (a+b)ᵖ = aᵖ + bᵖ because p divides the middle binomial coefficients. Frobenius generates Gal(𝔽_{pⁿ}/𝔽_p) and governs separability phenomena unique to characteristic p.
